column2: Diagrams: how do I make a quarters table, a tree of a name’s variants, pedigree collapse loops or a double fan?
column3: Charts → My diagrams → ＋ New. “🛡️ Quarters table”: the 8, 16 or 32 ancestors of one generation with the coats of arms from their records (Lists → Coats of arms). “🌿 Tree of a name’s variants”: the forms of a name on a year axis, linked to the one they come from. In the existing types: Kinship path → “Pedigree collapse loops” (all paths between the two parents and the inbreeding coefficient); Hourglass → “Two fans” shape; Network → “The whole family, one dot per couple”; Venn → 2 to 8 sets, as crossed bars from 5; Accordion tree → “In circles”; Ancestor grid → “Periodic-table cells”; Pyramid → “A census”; timelines → “Show date uncertainty”; Decorative tree → “Bow tie”. “From the app” fills the table (person, generations, group of people, period, ＋ Criterion); everything can still be edited by hand afterwards.
